title: Temora, NSW - Infrastructure Restoration
current_summary: An upstream provider has resolved an unplanned outage that affected some services in Temora, NSW. Impacted customers may have experienced a loss of connectivity. Services were restored by 7:00 pm AEST on 3 July 2026. If you are still experiencing issues, please restart your modem/router and contact us if the problem continues.

updates.content: An unplanned outage affecting some services in Temora, NSW has been resolved. Services were restored by 7:00 pm AEST on 3 July 2026. If you remain offline, please restart your modem/router. If the issue persists, get in touch and we’ll help. Thank you for your patience.
